author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಅತಿಸಣ್ಣ ಕೊರತೆಗಳು ದೊಡ್ಡ ಜನಗಳಲಿಹವು
ಮತಿಗೆಟ್ಟು ವರ್ತಿಪರು ಸುತ್ತಲರಿವಿರದೆ
ಗತಿಗಾಣೆ ಕೊನೆಗವರು ತಮ್ಮನಡೆ ತಾವಹಿಸೆ
ಚಿತೆಯೆಡೆಗೆ ಅವರನಡೆ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Great people have their very small failings;
they lose their judgement and act without knowing their surroundings;
when their course is seen through at last, as they own their deeds,
their path heads toward the pyre, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Even great people have small flaws that can undo them when they stop paying attention to the world around them. In the end they must answer for their actions.
